question: Why is the division of parts declared in the illumination of the seals?
premises: The division of parts is declared in the illumination of the seals.
This begins from the teaching of the lord of the thirty-two principles.
The subject matter is very clear from that point onward.
inference: The division of parts in the context of seals is clearly explained starting from the doctrine of the thirty-two principles.
plain_english: The division of parts is thus declared in the illumination of the seals, because it is very clear beginning from the teaching of the lord of the thirty-two principles.
